verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an experimentation and feature-flag platform, but the evidence shows no recurring scheduler. Rule scheduling and ramp schedules (docs-22, docs-37, docs-61) are one-off or progressive timed rollouts of a single rule, not recurring jobs or workflows. Automating flag toggles from a deploy script through the REST API (docs-58) is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
